name: Ar'gorok
summary: Ar'gorok is an open geographic area in the northwestern Arathi Highlands, situated along the rolling plateau north of Stromgarde. In the present era of 25 ADP, it remains wild highlands terrain near the borderlands of the region. Travelers crossing northwestern Arathi must contend with the indigenous beasts and the ever-shifting territorial tensions between the Alliance, the Horde, and local syndicates.

sections.title: The Northwestern Frontier
sections.body: Positioned in the northwestern reaches of the Arathi Highlands, the area known as Ar'gorok lies on the open plains between the heights of Thoradin's Wall and the basin of the Dabyrie's Farmstead. Unlike the fortified redoubts of Hammerfall or the ruins of Stromgarde, the open plateau here is dominated by roaming plainstalkers, raptors, and spiders. While various forces cast covetous eyes on strategic high ground throughout the Highlands, the expanse remains a wild, contested borderland exposed to the harsh mountain winds.

faq.answer: Ar'gorok lies in the northwestern quadrant of the Arathi Highlands, north of the main road that cuts through the region and west of the central plains.

faq.q: Is Ar'gorok a fortified Horde stronghold in the present day?
faq.answer: No. In the current era of 25 ADP, Ar'gorok is not an active fortress. The primary Horde stronghold in the Arathi Highlands is Hammerfall to the northeast. The northwestern highlands are largely wilderness contested by wild beasts and passing patrols.

faq.q: What threats wander this part of the Arathi Highlands?
faq.answer: The open plateau around Ar'gorok is prowled by regional wildlife such as plains creepers and raptors, alongside roaming rogue elements and Syndicate operatives active in nearby foothills.
The name Ar'gorok bears the hallmarks of an Orcish settlement or encampment site, reflecting the Horde's ongoing military interest and historical maneuvers across the Arathi Highlands.

angles.text: While Hammerfall remains the foundation of Horde presence in Arathi, scouting expeditions frequently survey the northwestern bluffs of Ar'gorok to monitor movements near Thoradin's Wall.
Alliance forces stationed at Refuge Pointe keep watch on the wild northern plateaus, wary of any potential Horde encroachment toward Hillsbrad.
